inspect_text: A small room of fitted stone, close enough that your shoulders nearly brush the walls. The floor is a grid: thin lines cross at every intersection, and at each crossing a small hollow has been worn smooth.

features.label: a grid scored into the floor
features.inspect_text: Thin lines cross the floor at right angles, forming a pattern of squares. The intersections are marked with small depressions, worn smooth by something placed and removed many times.

title: A Hall of Crossing Paths
summary: A wide hall where two paths cross at right angles, worn into the floor by centuries of traffic.
inspect_text: Two paths cross here at a clean right angle, worn deep into the stone. Where they meet, the floor is polished mirror-smooth, as if generations of feet passed through this single point.

features.label: worn crossing paths
features.inspect_text: Two paths cross here, worn into the stone. Where they meet, the floor is polished smooth. The intersections feel deliberate, like points on a grid.

title: A Hall of Pale Stone
summary: A hall of pale, almost white stone that holds whatever light there is. At its center, a golem waits.
inspect_text: Everything here is pale, almost white, and the stone seems to trap what little light falls on it, glowing gently. A pale golem waits at the center of the hall.

features.label: luminous pale stone
features.inspect_text: The stone holds light like a memory. The grid lines on the floor glow faintly, as if something is beneath them.

title: A Corridor of Worn Flags
summary: A long corridor paved in stone flags cut to a single size. Where they meet, their joints form clean, straight lines.
inspect_text: The corridor runs straight under your feet. Each stone flag is cut to the same size, and the joints between them run true, north to south, an unbroken line of seams.

features.label: the fitted flagstones
features.inspect_text: Each flag is cut to fit precisely against its neighbors. The joints form lines that cross at right angles, a grid drawn in stone.

title: The Mushroom Grove
summary: A cavern floor is choked with pale mushrooms, all leaning toward the glowing canopy above. The air smells of wet earth and something sweet, like crushed fruit.
inspect_text: Pale mushrooms crowd the floor, every cap leaning toward the glowing canopy above. The air holds wet earth and something sweet — crushed fruit, or a thing that ripened down here.

title: A Glowing Clearing
summary: A wide clearing lit by drifting spores that pulse slowly, like a heartbeat. Overhead a false sky shimmers, bright enough to read by, wrong enough to notice.
inspect_text: Spores drift across this clearing at a slow, even pulse, lighting the ground beneath your feet. Above, a false sky shimmers faintly — steady enough to read by, wrong enough that you notice.

inspect_text: Far above, a crack in the roof lets in a column of pale light that pools on the moss by your feet. It is the first true light you have seen down here, and it is very old.

summary: A crack in the cavern roof opens far above, and through it falls a light like starlight, pooling onto a bed of moss. You tilt your head back to watch it.

title: The Deep Glade
summary: The air here is still and old, and the hum of this forest is loudest at your back. Glowing vines hang around you like curtains, their light slow and steady.
inspect_text: Still, old air lines this glade, and the forest hum is loudest here. Curtains of glowing vine hang heavy around you, their light riding the same slow pulse as the spores of the outer woods.

title: The King's Grove
summary: The forest parts into a wide, still chamber. At its heart, enthroned in roots and pale light, sits the elf king, watching the entrance — watching you.
inspect_text: The trees open at last into a wide, still chamber. In a throne woven of roots and pale light sits the elf king, and he is looking at the entrance, at you, with no hurry at all.

descriptions.summary: The forest opens into a wide, still chamber. Where the elf king once sat enthroned in roots and pale light, only a hollowed throne of grey bark remains.

title: The North Offering
summary: A great dish of black glass stands against the north wall like an open mouth, gathering the ring that circles the board toward it.
inspect_text: The store of the board: where the gathered stones were poured and counted. The glass around it is cool, but you know the heat this room was made to hold.

features.label: the fire-bowl
features.inspect_text: A wide dish of black glass, deep as a man's chest. Its lip is scored where embers have been poured in and cleared away a thousand times.

title: The South Store
summary: The ring bends south into a second dish, shallower than the first, and at its bottom a single ember smoulders.
inspect_text: The far store of the board. One seed has been left behind — warm, steady, waiting for a hand to move it.

features.label: the fire-bowl
features.inspect_text: A wide dish of black glass. A single ember smoulders at its bottom, the last seed of the south store.

title: A Basin of Cooling Embers
summary: A round chamber floored in black glass. In its center a broad depression holds one red coal that never quite dies.
inspect_text: A round chamber floored in black glass. A single coal breathes in the depression, skirted by black glass. It does not warm the room — only the memory of warmth.

features.label: the glass basin
features.inspect_text: A single coal breathes in the depression, skirted by black glass. It does not warm the room — only the memory of warmth.

title: A Basin of Kept Embers
summary: A round chamber floored in black glass. A film of embers lies over the glass, caught like seeds before sowing.
inspect_text: A round chamber floored in black glass. Tiny embers fleck the floor like a scatter of seed, slightly warmer under the fingers than the surrounding glass.

features.label: the glass basin
features.inspect_text: Tiny embers fleck the floor like a scatter of seed, slightly warmer under the fingers than the surrounding glass.

title: A Basin Between Two Stores
summary: A round chamber floored in black glass. Two faint lines of carved glass race away to either hand, joining the ring at the far store.
inspect_text: A round chamber floored in black glass. Two scored lines run out of this chamber and vanish around the curve of the ring.

features.label: the glass basin
features.inspect_text: Two scored lines run out of this chamber and vanish around the curve of the ring.

title: A Basin of Ashen Glass
summary: A round chamber floored in black glass. The bowl is cracked and cold, its stones pale as ash.
inspect_text: A round chamber floored in black glass. The crack runs through the center of the bowl. Whatever burned here has long been taken.

features.label: the glass basin
features.inspect_text: The crack runs through the center of the bowl. Whatever burned here has long been taken.

title: A Basin That Remembers Fire
summary: A round chamber floored in black glass. A dull warmth rises through the floor, here at the board's one true hearth.
inspect_text: A round chamber floored in black glass. Heat wells up gently through the seams. Beneath, you sense the same dead fire you have felt all along: banked, waiting.

features.label: the glass basin
features.inspect_text: Heat wells up gently through the seams. Beneath, you sense the same dead fire you have felt all along: banked, waiting.

title: A Basin Near the South Store
summary: A round chamber floored in black glass. The ring bends south toward a tall dark offering dish.
inspect_text: A round chamber floored in black glass. The southern store is a tall column of shadow on the rim, its dish holding the last of the board's gathered light.

features.label: the glass basin
features.inspect_text: The southern store is a tall column of shadow on the rim, its dish holding the last of the board's gathered light.

title: A Basin of the Turning Board
summary: A round chamber floored in black glass. The glass underfoot is worn to a shine, as if countless stones were slid across it.
inspect_text: A round chamber floored in black glass. The floor is glass worn mirror-smooth, the recorded arc of a thousand unseen moves.

features.label: the glass basin
features.inspect_text: The floor is glass worn mirror-smooth, the recorded arc of a thousand unseen moves.

title: A Basin Where Seeds Were Slid
summary: A round chamber floored in black glass. A scatter of seed-shaped embers sits in the bowl, none of them lit.
inspect_text: A round chamber floored in black glass. Embers sit one by one, evenly spaced, exactly as seeds would be set out before a game.

features.label: the glass basin
features.inspect_text: Embers sit one by one, evenly spaced, exactly as seeds would be set out before a game.

title: A Basin of Deep Stillness
summary: A round chamber floored in black glass. Nothing moves. The stillness here is older than the black glass itself.
inspect_text: A round chamber floored in black glass. The air is cold and still. Even the ancient warmth of the board does not reach here.

features.label: the glass basin
features.inspect_text: The air is cold and still. Even the ancient warmth of the board does not reach here.

title: A Basin of the Long Ring
summary: A round chamber floored in black glass. The ring stretches long in both directions, one arc fading into gloom.
inspect_text: A round chamber floored in black glass. The ring doubles back on itself for a long way before either store or center appears.

features.label: the glass basin
features.inspect_text: The ring doubles back on itself for a long way before either store or center appears.

title: A Basin on the Far Arc
summary: A round chamber floored in black glass. Far across the dark, the heart of the board glows a faint, banked orange.
inspect_text: A round chamber floored in black glass. Across the dark the heart-pit burns at a steady, unhurried orange.

features.label: the glass basin
features.inspect_text: Across the dark the heart-pit burns at a steady, unhurried orange.

title: A Basin at the North Store
summary: A round chamber floored in black glass. Northward, a monumental bowl gathers the ring into itself.
inspect_text: A round chamber floored in black glass. The north store's dish shelves up beyond the rim, its mouth drinking the ring.

features.label: the glass basin
features.inspect_text: The north store's dish shelves up beyond the rim, its mouth drinking the ring.

title: The Heart-Pit
summary: The ring's center opens into a shallow pit of black glass, and in it, on a cradle of embers, a fire burns — patient, watchful, alone.
inspect_text: The ring's center opens into a shallow pit of black glass. In the cradle, a clot of embers holds to a deep, steady heat. Something in it watches the edge of the pit.

descriptions.summary: The heart-pit is empty. Where the Fire Elemental burned, only a round cradle of black glass remains, still warm, holding a faint spiral of ash.
descriptions.inspect_text: The heart of the board is a shallow pit of black glass. Where the Fire Elemental burned, only a round cradle remains, still warm, holding a faint spiral of ash.

features.label: the coals
features.inspect_text: In the cradle of the pit, a clot of embers burns with a deep, steady heat. It does not crackle. It does not spread. It simply holds.
